name: Residence by Family Relationship

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or child of a Honduran citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Ley de Migracion y Extranjeria (Decreto 208-2003), Article 21: spouses of Honduran citizens, and children of Honduran nationals by birth (plus their relatives), may obtain residency on that basis.
requirements.fix_path: Apply to INM as the spouse or child of a Honduran citizen, providing marriage/birth certificates and standard background documentation.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of filiation

sources.title: Instituto Nacional de Migracion de Honduras -- hosted primary legal text of Decreto 208-2003, Article 21 (residence for spouses/children of Honduran citizens and their relatives)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Honduras). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced directly to the government-hosted primary statutory text, tier 1. This is a separate route from hn_citizenship_by_marriage.json: this file covers RESIDENCE by family relationship, the other covers the specific path to Honduran CITIZENSHIP via marriage. citizenship_after_months left null since Article 21 grants residence, not citizenship directly -- the naturalization clock (see hn_citizenship_naturalisation.json and hn_citizenship_by_marriage.json) is a separate, subsequent step. The same statute (Article 39(12)) separately extends family permits to relatives of contracted foreign workers -- see hn_work_permit.json.
